message.content: The new evidence resolves the remaining open claims: the engineered near-halfway window probe (t15, 3200 samples, residuals within ±600 of the exact boundary, |P|≈2^61, r=0) found 0 mismatches, and the fixed r-sweep probe (t16, 4160 samples across r=0..31 including a=-2^31 and a=2^31-1 extremes, exact-halfway rows, and nonsaturating targets) found 0 mismatches. The fp64 precision-loss hypothesis (c1/c3) is now decisively tested in the highest-risk windows and rebuts the off-by-one concern; c2 was already rebutted. No new material in-scope problems are exposed.
